keyword_queries: AI agent sandbox Firecracker gVisor comparison benchmarks
E2B Modal Daytona sandbox cold start snapshot
Cloudflare sandbox devcontainers agent network egress isolation
objective: Question: What sandboxing approaches are used for autonomous agents (Firecracker microVMs, gVisor, e2b, Modal, Daytona, Cloudflare, devcontainers)? Compare startup time, isolation strength, snapshot/resume, cost, and network egress control, with any published benchmarks. Pages that should rank first are primary sources: the organisations' own engineering blog posts, documentation, talks, papers, and source code (Firecracker, gVisor, E2B, Modal, Daytona, Cloudflare Sandbox/Containers, devcontainers spec), plus credible independent benchmarks and reporting. Pull out mechanisms (microVM vs user-space kernel vs container), cold start and resume numbers in milliseconds, isolation and security model, snapshot/restore features, pricing per vCPU-second, network egress policy options, measured results, dates, and known failure modes or limitations.
